title: EDG Community Update: Week of August 29th, 2022
body:
## **Highlights**

- [Edgeverse wallet by Bharathcoorg](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1565319824187822081) is now available on the Firefox browser.
- [Edgeware Trading Week](https://twitter.com/kucoincom/status/1564522013984665601) consisting of 3 campaigns on Kucoin Exchange had been kicked off on 30th August with a reward pool of 23M EDG for traders.
- The StickerCompetition aka campaign 4 from The Cutting Edge Conquest series concluded on 28th August and [winners have been announced](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1564331679162023937).
- All the Validators, RPC infrastructure providers, Exchanges and Ecosystem Projects can upgrade their nodes to the [pre-release v3.5.1](https://github.com/edgeware-network/edgeware-node/releases/tag/v3.5.1) to be prepared in advance for the upcoming ERUP5 upgrade's on-chain democracy proposal.
- Upcoming Activities/Events: The Cutting Edge Conquest campaigns(ongoing), Kabocha's Community Mods Onboarding Quiz

## **Ecosystem Updates**

- Edgeware got featured in the [case study by OnFinality](https://twitter.com/OnFinality/status/1565323615955873792).
- Want to run a validator node for Edgeware solochain but don't have technical knowledge? [OnFinality's 5-step guided validator deployment](https://app.onfinality.io/) got you covered!
- Get to know more technical-oriented updates on the '[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-aug-28/)'.
- Looking for the speculative performance of EDG? Check out the [Community-run DAO Financial Bulletins](https://blog.edgewa.re/tag/bi-weekly/).
- EDGizens are welcome to participate in [the research survey](https://forms.gle/XdjEyBEMY1EtZs3x9) by one of the ecosystem partners.
- Community Treasury-funded Web3 Media platform, [New-Futures opened up pre-registrations](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1469353591433478150?s=20) for their highly anticipated upcoming launch.
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainli
